name: slime-king-unplayable-with-only-two-distinct-slime-elements
notes: Slime King (f0ymeslfpw): the mandatory banish-three-Slimes-with-different-elements additional cost must be payable or the card cannot be activated. Graveyard = Red Slime, Red Slime, Storm Slime: three Slime allies but only TWO distinct elements (FIRE, ARCANE), so playing Slime King from hand is refused up front -- activateCardPrereqs['f0ymeslfpw:0'] (generated play prereq) fails with the flash message 'Slime King requires 3 Slime allies with different elements in your graveyard.' Nothing is banished, no reserve cost is paid, Slime King stays in hand. (The new DoActivateCard branch re-checks the same condition defensively.) Negative-path complement of slime-king-additional-cost-banishes-three-distinct-slimes. The 10002 click itself reports success to the runner (the engine just refuses silently with the flash), so the proof is the unchanged zones plus the flash message.

rulesClauses: As an additional cost to activate this card, banish three Slime ally cards each with different elements from your graveyard.
